meta.title: Consulting, delivery and support in Rīga
meta.description: Replace this with one sentence describing what the business does and who it is for. It is the line that appears under the site's name in search results.

hero.title: A short, concrete promise
hero.subtitle: One or two sentences saying what you do, for whom, and why someone should read further. Say the thing plainly. A visitor decides in about five seconds.

highlights.title: Why work with us
highlights.subtitle: Three reasons, each worth a sentence.

clarity.title: A clear price
clarity.body: You know the cost before the work begins. No hourly surprises at the end of the month.

speed.title: A real timeline
speed.body: We say when it will be done and then it is done then. If something slips you hear it from us first.

care.title: One person to call
care.body: You deal with the same person from the first conversation to the last, not a queue.

services.title: What we do
services.subtitle: A short line framing the list below.

about.title: Who you are dealing with
about.body: Two or three sentences of substance about the business: how long it has been going, what it is good at, and who is behind it. Specifics beat adjectives: a number, a place, a year.

cta.title: Tell us what you need
cta.body: Send a message and we will answer the same working day.
